label.explanation: auth-svc briefly lost one of four instances (line 189) and was back within a minute (line 197). But account-svc retries 503s immediately with backoff disabled (lines 196, 200, 204, 209), multiplying load on auth-svc past its capacity so it keeps shedding (lines 201, 215, 217). The overload sustains itself long after the trigger; the shed requests (lines 208, 225, 242, 259, 270) and edge 503s (lines 203, 218, 231, 244, 250, 269, 278) are symptoms. Fix the retry policy / add a retry budget. Red herrings: lines 96, 104 (a deploy of audit-consumer, which is not on the failing request path and kept processing normally); line 38 (a one-off slow reporting query on audit_log, not on the failing request path).
